movie.title: A Toxic Love Story
movie.overview: A string of threatening emails escalates into a revenge plot involving a newly married US marshal and his ex-girlfriend.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: A newly married US marshal finds his life unraveling when a barrage of sinister emails transforms into a dark revenge campaign orchestrated by his obsessed ex-girlfriend.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: A Toxic Love Story explores a chilling real-life drama that unfolds when a newly married US marshal becomes the target of an escalating cyber-harassment campaign. As mysterious, threatening emails flood in, what initially appears to be random intimidation rapidly mutates into a calculated plot for revenge. Investigating the digital trail uncovers a web of obsession centered around the marshal's ex-girlfriend. This harrowing documentary dramatizes the destructive fallout of bitter past relationships in the modern digital age.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: A Toxic Love Story is a dramatic documentary that reconstructs the shocking narrative of a newly married US marshal whose domestic peace is suddenly shattered by anonymous harassment. The turmoil begins with a series of vague, menacing emails delivered to both the marshal and his new bride, creating an atmosphere of constant paranoia. As time passes, the digital threats escalate in frequency and malice, moving from eerie messages to dangerous real-world interference. Federal investigators step in to trace the digital breadcrumbs, working through encrypted accounts and spoofed IP addresses to identify the culprit. The psychological toll on the newlywed couple grows immense as the harasser demonstrates intimate knowledge of their personal schedules and routines. Ultimately, the investigation reveals the perpetrator to be the marshal's former girlfriend, who refused to accept the end of their relationship. Driven by jealousy, her complex revenge plot aimed to systematically dismantle his career, marriage, and peace of mind. Through dramatic reenactments, intimate interviews, and digital evidence logs, the documentary examines the dangerous intersection of romantic fixation and modern cyber-stalking. The film concludes by exposing the far-reaching legal and emotional consequences of a love turned deadly.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: A Toxic Love Story is an unsettling documentary drama that delves into the dark side of romantic obsession and cyber-stalking. Following a newly married US marshal whose quiet life is disrupted by a relentless campaign of threatening emails, the film explores how modern technology can be weaponized into a powerful tool for vengeance. As investigators race against time to unmask the source of the intimidation, they uncover a deeply personal vendetta rooted in a former romance. Grounded in psychological drama, the film offers a sobering look at how past relationships can cast long, dangerous shadows over a hopeful future.

story_structure.climax: The escalating plot culminates in a direct, high-stakes confrontation where the marshal must make a critical choice to permanently neutralize the threat and secure his family's survival.
story_structure.conflict: The threats are traced back to the marshal's unstable ex-girlfriend, transforming the digital harassment into a tangible, deeply personal revenge plot that directly threatens his marriage and safety.
story_structure.resolution: With the immediate danger resolved, the marshal and his wife are left to process the emotional trauma and pick up the pieces, determined to rebuild their lives and strengthen their marriage in the aftermath.
story_structure.introduction: A newly married US marshal attempts to settle into his new life, but the shadows of his past loom large as a series of anonymous, threatening emails begins to target him and his new spouse.
story_structure.risingAction: As the ex-girlfriend's tactics grow increasingly hostile and sophisticated, the marshal must use his professional skills to protect his wife, leading to a tense game of cat-and-mouse that pushes his resourcefulness and vows to the limit.
